proposal_ref: P1 cooperating local CLI submission and publication checks, implementation pending

policy_refs.status: P0 observation profile, not execution authority

factors: Lifecycle changes can block valid submissions or publish unreviewed content if bindings are incomplete
Local checks run under the same writable checkout and user identity

requirements.requirement: Enroll only selected new tasks before their product edits; pin repository identity, exact four-field scope, baseline, mode and applicable profile/policy
requirements.acceptance: A new selected task is enrolled, and missing or altered enrollment/profile blocks compliant lifecycle entry points; existing tasks remain explicitly legacy
requirements.evidence: Positive enrollment and deletion/downgrade/scope-change regression tests

requirements.requirement: Submission binds exact candidate paths/content, applicable policy, deterministic check evidence and independent review evidence
requirements.acceptance: Missing, malformed, failed, inconclusive, rework, stale or mismatched evidence prevents submission; declared reviewer conflicts are rejected
requirements.evidence: Targeted negative tests and actual independent evaluator record

requirements.requirement: Separate durable P1 review validity from P0 observation TTL
requirements.acceptance: Material candidate, policy or evidence change invalidates review, while ordinary report packaging does not create an endless five-minute review cycle
requirements.evidence: Changed-content rejection and unchanged-content packaging success

requirements.requirement: Define and seal generated reporting records without circular self-hashing
requirements.acceptance: Reviewed subject excludes only explicitly reproducible derived metadata; all remaining publication bytes are reviewed or deterministically validated and sealed
requirements.evidence: Documentation of the subject and generated-record boundary plus mutation rejection tests

requirements.requirement: Check actual Git commit objects immediately before push
requirements.acceptance: Commit parent, complete changed-path set, tree objects, scope and destination match the sealed submitted subject and exact standing grant; stale worktree hashes cannot substitute for commit content
requirements.evidence: Changed commit/path/destination and content mismatch regression tests

requirements.requirement: Preserve pending commits and reconcile retries
requirements.acceptance: A gate or transport failure leaves the pending commit inspectable; retry verifies the same commit and never force-pushes or creates a duplicate completion commit

requirements.requirement: Fail closed only the selected affected lifecycle action
requirements.acceptance: Missing gate implementation/configuration/evidence and unexpected errors cannot silently fall back to success for enrolled tasks; separately authorized diagnostics remain available

requirements.requirement: Demonstrate actual activation after tests and independent review
requirements.acceptance: Repository configuration selects the intended development scope and a newly initialized real task exercises blocking before evidence and successful submission/publication after valid evidence
requirements.evidence: Actual enrolled application task, rejection and success records, verified remote commit

requirements.requirement: Preserve result contract 1.0.0, old task snapshots and P0 observation behavior
requirements.acceptance: No historical task is relabelled enforced and unselected legacy lifecycle remains compatible
requirements.evidence: Legacy/P0 regression suite and source diff review

requirements.acceptance: Reports identify cooperating local CLI enforcement, declared identity and locally supplied evidence; they do not claim authenticated reviewers, protected trust storage, trusted signed tests, content scanning, direct Git blocking, OS isolation or regulatory certification
requirements.evidence: User guide, task specification and independent review

review_needed.authority_question: none for this bounded implementation and exact configured publication
review_needed.reason: The user explicitly requested implementation, testing, independent review, application, saved specifications and Git push; existing standing authorization specifies origin/main. New remote, branch, deployment or credential scope is not authorized by this assessment.

conditions: Independent evaluator must inspect implementation and actual test evidence before completion
The parent implementation task predates activation and must not be retrospectively called P1-enforced
Use a separately enrolled application task to demonstrate the newly enabled lifecycle
Do not lower mandatory checks, fabricate approvals, or bypass a failed selected gate to finish
unresolved_obligations: Final source-level compliance and actual activation remain to be verified by independent evaluator
limitations: This artifact assesses a design, not completed implementation
Same-user writable local enrollment is consistency enforcement, not tamper-proof authority
Older CLI/direct Git paths and same-user evidence forgery remain outside the claimed P1 boundary
No production, external executor, authenticated signing service, remote protection rule or scheduled monitoring is provisioned

validity.basis: Current P0 implementation and authorized bounded P1 scope

verification.reason: Design advisory emitted before implementation completion
